text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see a Knight.
source_text: You see a Knight.

text: 你见到了一名骑士。
source_text: 你见到了一名骑士。

text: I wonder what the old turbine engines were really like.
source_text: I wonder what the old turbine engines were really like.

text: 我想知道老式涡轮引擎究竟是什么样子。
source_text: 我想知道老式涡轮引擎究竟是什么样子。

text: It would be great if we had a working automobile.
source_text: It would be great if we had a working automobile.

text: 我们要是有辆能发动的车就好了。
source_text: 我们要是有辆能发动的车就好了。

text: Did you know man has been on the moon? Or I think that's what they said.
source_text: Did you know man has been on the moon? Or I think that's what they said.

text: 你知道吗，人类曾经登上过月球？至少我想他们是这么说的。
source_text: 你知道吗，人类曾经登上过月球？至少我想他们是这么说的。

text: I can't find the file I need.
source_text: I can't find the file I need.

text: 我找不到我需要的文件。
source_text: 我找不到我需要的文件。

text: I'll be a Paladin someday.
source_text: I'll be a Paladin someday.

text: 总有一天我会成为游侠的。
source_text: 总有一天我会成为游侠的。

text: Talus is a skilled warrior. I would never want to have to go up against him.
source_text: Talus is a skilled warrior. I would never want to have to go up against him.

text: 塔鲁斯是个经验丰富的战士。我可不想和他对着干。
source_text: 塔鲁斯是个经验丰富的战士。我可不想和他对着干。

text: Thomas is the best fighter in the Brotherhood. I bet he could best Rhombus.
source_text: Thomas is the best fighter in the Brotherhood. I bet he could best Rhombus.

text: 托马斯是兄弟会里最好的战士。我敢打赌他能打败隆伯斯。
source_text: 托马斯是兄弟会里最好的战士。我敢打赌他能打败隆伯斯。

text: I'd like to get my hands on those raiders. Show them what thieves deserve.
source_text: I'd like to get my hands on those raiders. Show them what thieves deserve.

text: 我想收拾这帮强盗。让他们知道知道小偷应有的下场。
source_text: 我想收拾这帮强盗。让他们知道知道小偷应有的下场。

text: That's it . . . what? Oh sorry. I can't talk right now.
source_text: That's it . . . what? Oh sorry. I can't talk right now.

text: 那是什么……什么来着？哦抱歉。我现在不能聊天。
source_text: 那是什么……什么来着？哦抱歉。我现在不能聊天。

text: I wonder . . . huh? Oh, you made me lose my train of thought.
source_text: I wonder . . . huh? Oh, you made me lose my train of thought.

text: 我想……呃？喔，你打断我的思路了。
source_text: 我想……呃？喔，你打断我的思路了。

text: I love working on new prototypes.
source_text: I love working on new prototypes.

text: 我喜欢按照新原型工作。
source_text: 我喜欢按照新原型工作。

text: When our supplies are limited, it can really be a challenge to find a way to use what we've got.
source_text: When our supplies are limited, it can really be a challenge to find a way to use what we've got.

text: 当我们的补给有限时，怎样合理使用资源确实是个挑战。
source_text: 当我们的补给有限时，怎样合理使用资源确实是个挑战。

text: I can't figure out why my last prototype didn't work.
source_text: I can't figure out why my last prototype didn't work.

text: 我不明白为什么我最新的原型无法工作。
source_text: 我不明白为什么我最新的原型无法工作。

text: Sorry, can't talk right now.
source_text: Sorry, can't talk right now.

text: 抱歉，现在没法聊天。
source_text: 抱歉，现在没法聊天。

text: Vree's over there.
source_text: Vree's over there.

text: 弗蕾在那里。
source_text: 弗蕾在那里。

text: Now where did I put that file . . .
source_text: Now where did I put that file . . .

text: 我把那文件放到哪儿去了……
source_text: 我把那文件放到哪儿去了……

text: Where's that schematic?
source_text: Where's that schematic?

text: 图纸在哪儿？
source_text: 图纸在哪儿？

text: Well the computer says it should work; now what did I do wrong?
source_text: Well the computer says it should work; now what did I do wrong?

text: 好吧，电脑说它能运转的；我到底搞错了什么？
source_text: 好吧，电脑说它能运转的；我到底搞错了什么？
